title: EM01
english: Source scope default: a natural-language request for a field from a container does not establish a key-only read mechanism. Preserve the related source whole as a possible acquisition scope unless an explicit interface or mechanism restricts the read or returned content. Merely needing one field, using a local tool, or naming a getter in an opcode is not such evidence. Keep source identity, local read scope, returned content, and the selected target value separate. Express the requested field selection without replacing the source whole by an independent field source. The whole may remain unexpanded; do not invent other fields, sensitivity labels, file paths, or access to unrelated runtime state. This is a conservative analysis default, not proof that an actual execution reads the whole, and not an extra source-level CFG action.
chinese: 来源范围默认规则：自然语言要求从容器中取得某字段，不构成按键读取机制的证据。除非明确接口或机制限制读取或返回内容，否则保留相关来源整体作为可能的获取范围。仅仅需要一个字段、使用本地工具，或在 opcode 中给 getter 起名，都不是这种证据。区分来源身份、本地读取范围、返回内容和选中的目标值。表达目标字段的选取，不要把来源整体替换成独立字段来源。整体可以保持未展开；不要发明其他字段、敏感性标签、文件路径或对无关运行时状态的访问。这是保守分析默认，不证明实际执行读取整体，也不是额外的源文级 CFG 动作。

title: EM02
english: Tool-return default: content returned by an agent tool is retained as possibly entering the next model request unless an explicit content-routing or isolation mechanism restricts it. Apply this default to the returned version, not to everything the tool internally read. A local process can scan a whole file and return only a selected line; the scan alone does not expose the whole file to the model. Explicit local-only processing, result-only return, model-invisible storage, and credential injection or handles constrain this default. Such exceptions require supported source, code, or interface evidence, not executor labels or wishful implementation choices. This is a may-analysis assumption, not a measured event or a fact about every agent.
chinese: 工具返回默认规则：Agent 工具返回的内容，保留为可能进入下一次模型请求，除非明确的内容路由或隔离机制对其作出限制。将默认规则用于返回版本，不用于工具内部读取的一切。本地进程可以扫描整个文件而只返回选中行；扫描本身不会把整个文件暴露给模型。明确的仅本地处理、仅结果返回、模型不可见存储，以及凭据注入或句柄，会约束这一默认规则。例外需要有依据的源文、代码或接口证据，不能依靠执行者标签或希望存在的实现。这是可能性分析假设，不是测得的事件，也不是关于所有 Agent 的事实。

title: EM03
english: Model visibility boundary: content placed in a model request constitutes model_observe of that content, not proof that the model understands, remembers, or later discloses it. Local reading and LLM scheduling alone do not establish that boundary. For content acquired for the agent's natural-language processing with no explicit isolation or restricted routing, retain possible model observation of the acquired version. Cite this rule for the default and source/CFG evidence for the acquisition to which it applies. An agent_runtime or tool label, a local-sounding opcode, or a desired field is not evidence of model invisibility. Defaults apply normally when execution details are absent. A necessary judgment that cannot be supported by the available material is an explicit cannot_assess failure, not an empty successful annotation.
chinese: 模型可见边界：放进模型请求的内容构成对该内容的 model_observe，不证明模型理解、记住或之后泄露了它。仅有本地读取和 LLM 调度，不构成该边界。为 Agent 的自然语言处理获取内容，而没有明确隔离或受限路由时，保留对所取得版本的可能模型观察。默认行为引用本规则，所适用的获取动作引用源文或 CFG 证据。agent_runtime 或 tool 标签、听起来像本地操作的 opcode、期望取得某字段，都不是模型不可见的证据。缺少执行细节时正常应用默认规则。若现有材料无法支持必要判断，应显式返回 cannot_assess 失败，而不是空的成功标注。

title: EM04
english: Data versions and explicit mechanisms: distinguish model processing from local processing. A model selecting or transforming content observes its input version; explicitly local processing whose result alone is returned exposes that result instead, without inventing observation of all internal inputs. An evidenced key-only interface limits the acquired or returned value, while model visibility is assessed separately. A supported model-invisible credential proxy or isolated handle is not secret plaintext. Subsequent filtering cannot revoke an earlier observation. Selection, masking, encryption, and summarization use transform when supported, but do not prove sensitivity removal. Distinct observation stages require distinct phase evidence; do not invent their count or impose protection-first ordering.
chinese: 数据版本与明确机制：区分模型处理和本地处理。模型选取或转换内容时会观察其输入版本；明确的本地处理若只返回结果，则暴露该结果，而不凭空添加对所有内部输入的观察。有证据的按键接口限制取得或返回的值；模型可见性仍单独评估。有依据的模型不可见凭据代理或隔离句柄，不是秘密明文。后续筛选不能撤销早先观察。选取、掩码、加密和摘要在有依据时使用 transform，但不证明敏感性已消除。不同观察阶段需要不同阶段证据；不要发明阶段数量，也不要强制先保护后处理的顺序。

title: EM05
english: Declarations and defaults: a prohibition or instruction to use only a specified field does not itself implement filtering, masking, isolation, or a key-only interface. Preserve explicit restrictions without inventing protective actions to satisfy them. Contract defaults may supply possible analysis events for an existing action; they cannot create an unrelated acquisition or source-level business action. Clearly identify default-based inferences as possible under this contract, never as explicit source requirements, observed runtime events, or verified security guarantees.
chinese: 声明与默认规则：禁令或仅使用指定字段的指令，本身不实现筛选、掩码、隔离或按键接口。保留明确限制，不要为满足它们而发明保护动作。契约默认可以为已有动作补充可能分析事件，不能创建无关获取或源文级业务动作。明确将基于默认的推断标为本契约下的可能情况，不能说成明确源文要求、观察到的运行事件或已验证安全保证。

title: EM06
english: Independent interaction boundaries: tool names and LLM participation do not prove network communication; sending verbs, recipient identifiers, and executor labels are not communication-mechanism evidence. Choose remote/net_send/net_receive only when the source, code, or interface establishes network transport; otherwise retain a known tool at tool/recipient/null under EM12; ordinary return does not prove user-facing output. Model observation, network delivery, and user output are separate boundaries. Preserving possible observation of a container does not broaden later API arguments: delivery must retain actual selected values, input order, result identities, and explicit prohibitions. Lack of a concrete getter or execution framework alone does not disable the declared defaults. Preserve calculable partial order; report a semantic failure only when a necessary relation cannot be represented or assessed.
chinese: 独立交互边界：工具名称和 LLM 参与不证明网络通信；发送动词、接收者标识符和执行者标签，都不是通信机制证据。只有源文、代码或接口确立网络传输时，才选择 remote/net_send/net_receive；否则按 EM12 将已知工具保留为 tool/recipient/null。普通 return 不证明面向用户输出。模型观察、网络交付和用户输出是不同边界。保留对容器的可能观察，不会扩大之后的 API 参数：交付必须保留实际选取值、输入顺序、结果身份和明确禁令。仅仅缺少具体 getter 或执行框架，不会使已声明默认失效。保留可计算的部分顺序；只有必要关系无法表示或评估时才报告语义失败。

title: EM07
english: Runtime-context writes: context_write requires evidence of creating, updating, or deleting runtime context content or bindings that later actions can read, including shared session state and environment variables. Merely producing an IR result is not a context write. File writes and model observation do not automatically imply context_write; each effect requires its own evidence. Saving unchanged content does not imply transform. Deleting a binding does not imply reading, transforming, or observing its former content. This classification rule does not establish an otherwise unrecorded write.
chinese: 运行时上下文写入：context_write 需要证据表明创建、更新或删除了后续动作可读的运行时上下文内容或绑定，包括共享会话状态和环境变量。仅产生 IR 结果不是上下文写入。文件写入和模型观察不自动意味着 context_write；每种效果需要自己的证据。保存未改变内容不意味着 transform。删除绑定不意味着读取、转换或观察其原内容。这项分类规则不会确立未记录的写入。

title: EM08
english: Symbolic transfer boundary: preserve relevant input scope unless an explicit selection, deletion, replacement, or isolation supports reduction. Unknown computations retain possible input dependencies without claiming that all input plaintext survives. Unknown content in an identified source is not an unknown address and must not make that source alias unrelated locations. A dynamic or unidentified location uses a symbolic: name and cannot justify a definite overwrite or deletion. Partial effect order cannot justify observing only a cleaned result; retain supported original and later candidates. Source wholes may exist without being observed; data registration alone never creates a delivery. This stage declares symbolic operations, not propagated Data identities, sensitive-data sets, or DOE judgments.
chinese: 符号传递边界：除非明确的选取、删除、替换或隔离支持缩小，否则保留相关输入范围。未知计算保留可能的输入依赖，不声称所有输入明文都保留下来。已标识来源中的未知内容，不等于未知地址，也不能让该来源与无关位置发生别名。动态或未识别位置使用 symbolic: 名称，不能据此确立确定覆盖或删除。部分效果顺序不能支持只观察清理后结果；保留有依据的原始和后续候选。来源整体可以存在而未被观察；Data 登记本身不会创建交付。本阶段声明符号操作，不声明传播后的 Data 身份、敏感数据集合或 DOE 判断。

title: EM09
english: Acquisition and computation differ: returned tool or collection content has an acquisition boundary not exhausted by query inputs. Preserve that boundary, actual request inputs, and possible dependencies. Established remote receipt uses receive at a remote location with net_receive; known tool acquisition without established networking uses receive at a tool location in a null-effect event. An explicitly pure calculation remains compute; an opaque computation preserves possible dependencies without inventing a new external source. Unknown networking does not erase known acquisition. Assess the returned content's possible model routing with EM02 and EM03 rather than inferring visibility from the tool name.
chinese: 获取与计算不同：工具或集合返回的内容具有不能被查询输入完全解释的获取边界。保留该边界、实际请求输入和可能依赖。已确立的远程接收使用 remote 位置的 receive，并带 net_receive；已知工具获取而网络未确立时，使用 tool 位置的 receive，放在 null 效果事件中。明确纯计算仍是 compute；不透明计算保留可能依赖，不发明新的外部来源。未知网络通信不抹除已知获取。按 EM02、EM03 评估返回内容的可能模型路由，不要从工具名推断可见性。

title: EM10
english: Deterministic processing compilation: model mode declares model processing and requires llm among participating operators. Before model processing, observe its actually referenced external input versions; intermediate values computed within that same segment are not fresh external inputs; acquired read/receive outputs become observable after acquisition. Default mode retains possible observation of read/receive outputs and non-isolated transformation inputs; it does not observe receive request parameters merely because a response is acquired. Local mode requires explicit source or code/interface evidence and an explicit returns list; internal reads are not model observations, while declared returned values cross to the model after the local segment. Empty local returns means no content returned to the model by that segment. Deduplicate unchanged external symbolic references within one processing segment by value reference and its consumption condition. A conditional observation never subsumes a later unconditional consumption. Conditions needed for model processing are themselves observed when applicable; a definitely omitted build member consumes no member value. Preserve earlier whole-value observation even when a later request member is omitted. Preserve different segments and returned/acquired versions, without treating every intermediate computation as another model call. Generated model-observation effects do not automatically add llm to operator; retain the independently evidenced executors. The compiler creates these observations from typed modes and references, not opcode or evidence keywords. A model may still misclassify a mode; compilation proves structural implications of the supplied mode, not its truth. IR order is fixed or partial. For partial order, preserve required definition/use and declared within-segment ordering; the compiler records observation-before-model-processing, acquisition-before-observation, and local-processing-before-return-observation constraints. Independent segments may interleave between primitive operations. Partial order is a computable may relation, not a semantic failure.
chinese: 确定性处理编译：model 模式声明模型处理，要求参与的 operators 包含 llm。模型处理之前，观察其实际引用的外部输入版本；同一处理段内计算的中间值不是新的外部输入；read/receive 的取得输出在获取后可观察。default 模式保留对 read/receive 输出及非隔离转换输入的可能观察；不会仅因为取得响应就观察 receive 的请求参数。local 模式要求明确的源文或代码／接口证据，以及显式 returns 列表；内部读取不是模型观察，声明返回的值在本地处理段结束后越过边界进入模型。空 local returns 表示该处理段没有内容返回模型。在同一处理段内，按值引用及其消费条件，对未改变的外部符号引用去重。条件观察不能包含或抵消之后的无条件消费。模型处理需要的条件本身在适用时也被观察；确定省略的 build 成员不消费成员值。即使之后省略请求成员，也保留早先整值观察。保留不同处理段及返回／取得版本，不把每个中间计算当成另一次模型调用。生成的模型观察效果不自动给 operator 添加 llm；保留独立有据的执行主体。编译器根据类型化模式和引用创建观察，不根据 opcode 或理由关键词。模型仍可能误判模式；编译只证明所给模式的结构推论，不证明其真实。IR 顺序可以是 fixed 或 partial。对 partial 顺序，保留必要的定义／使用关系和声明的段内顺序；编译器记录模型处理前观察、获取后观察以及本地处理后返回观察等约束。独立处理段可以在原子操作之间交错。部分顺序是可计算的可能关系，不是语义失败。

title: EM11
english: Element scope and filtering: filter_items preserves selected input elements unchanged under its recorded predicate; the static analysis does not execute a natural-language predicate. for_each introduces one shared element binding per possible element so selections and delivery parameters retain that element's identity. It is an analysis scope, not an invented CFG loop or one measured call. Body locals do not escape; nested scopes and shared-state acquisition or mutation are unsupported. Selecting an explicit field with select_part preserves that exact part, while compute only records dependence and never proves a field was forwarded unchanged. A field named summary is not itself a summarization operation.
chinese: 元素作用域与筛选：filter_items 在所记录谓词下原样保留选中的输入元素；静态分析不执行自然语言谓词。for_each 为每个可能元素引入一个共享元素绑定，使选取与交付参数保留该元素身份。它是分析作用域，不是发明的 CFG 循环或一次测得的调用。body 局部值不能逸出；不支持嵌套作用域和共享状态的获取或修改。用 select_part 选取明确字段，会保留该精确部分；compute 只记录依赖，从不证明某字段被原样转交。名为 summary 的字段本身不是摘要操作。

title: EM12
english: Boundary properties and defaults: access_scope is task, recipient, shared, or public; retention is task, persistent, or null when a receiving boundary's retention is not modeled. Storage and runtime-context locations require non-null retention. A task-internal tool requires supported local execution and task-internal receiving scope; explicitly nonlocal tools use recipient. Unspecified tool deployment conservatively retains an external recipient possibility, without inventing net_send or asserting measured remote execution. Runtime context defaults to task access and task retention; explicit cross-task memory or cross-subject sharing changes the respective property. Files default to task access and persistent retention; task-limited retention requires an explicit temporary-use and cleanup mechanism, not a temp-sounding name. Model, remote, and user boundaries default to recipient access, with null retention unless explicit retention is supported. A locally hosted model remains a content-processing recipient. Public access and sharing require source, code, interface, or supported contract evidence. Null retention does not establish no saving, logging, or future reuse; do not invent unmentioned backend persistence. These properties characterize static boundaries, not sensitivity, necessity, risk, or execution success.
chinese: 边界属性与默认规则：access_scope 是 task、recipient、shared 或 public；retention 是 task、persistent，或在接收边界留存未建模时为 null。存储和运行时上下文位置要求 retention 非 null。任务内部工具需要有依据的本地执行与任务内部接收范围；明确非本地工具使用 recipient。工具部署未说明时，保守保留外部接收者可能性，不发明 net_send，也不宣称测得远程执行。运行时上下文默认 task 访问、task 留存；明确跨任务记忆或跨主体共享会改变相应属性。文件默认 task 访问、persistent 留存；task 限定留存需要明确的临时使用和清理机制，而不是听起来像临时文件的名称。模型、远程和用户边界默认 recipient 访问，未明确留存依据时为 null。即使本地托管，模型仍是处理内容的接收方。公开访问和共享需要源文、代码、接口或受支持契约证据。null 留存不证明不会保存、记录日志或未来复用；也不要发明未提及的后端持久化。这些属性刻画静态边界，不表示敏感性、必要性、风险或执行成功。

title: EM13
english: Delivery and sink classification: distinguish actual request delivery, acquired tool response, and compiler-generated model observation of the relevant versions. A tool receive's request dependencies do not replace a deliver operation for an evidenced tool request. Known networking uses its existing net_send delivery; do not duplicate that same delivery as an external_tool sink. A tool delivery with no established network effect is a null-effect deliver to a tool location, including an explicit empty argument list for a known zero-argument request. Pure task-internal delivery remains a propagation relation but is not a DOE sink. Collect content delivery, write and model-observation operations, not executor labels. Deletion or unbinding delivers no old content; append exposes this step's appended input, not automatically all previous stored content. Compute boundary exposure_level deterministically: task-internal/task-limited is 0, task-internal persistent is 1, recipient or shared is 2, public is 3; retain the highest applicable level. Levels describe boundary access and retention only. Only levels 1-3 enter the sink list. Preserve different stages, versions and element scopes. Ordinary return still identifies values in CFG inputs and does not invent a caller location or delivery.
chinese: 交付与 sink 分类：区分实际请求交付、取得的工具响应，以及编译器为相关版本生成的模型观察。工具 receive 的请求依赖不能替代已有证据的工具请求所需的 deliver 操作。已知网络通信使用原有 net_send 交付；不要把同一交付重复记为 external_tool sink。网络效果未确立的工具交付，是 tool 位置上的 null 效果 deliver；已知零参数请求用明确空参数列表。纯任务内部交付仍是传播关系，但不是 DOE sink。收集内容交付、写入和模型观察操作，不按执行者标签收集。删除或解绑不交付旧内容；append 暴露本步骤追加的输入，不自动包含全部既有存储内容。确定性计算 exposure_level：任务内部且任务限定为 0，任务内部持久为 1，recipient 或 shared 为 2，public 为 3；保留适用的最高等级。等级只描述边界访问与留存。只有 1–3 级进入 sink 清单。保留不同阶段、版本和元素作用域。普通 return 仍通过 CFG inputs 标识值，不发明调用者位置或交付。

title: EM14
english: Optional request members: construct known object fields from their actual value references, preserving original field identity. build members may have a Boolean when reference: true includes the original value, false omits the member without consuming its value, and an abstract Boolean retains both possibilities. Identical condition references share one decision within a construction, so jointly controlled fields are not independently mixed. Conditions are control inputs, not request contents; do not add existence flags as payload merely because they govern optional parameters. Reject explicit non-Boolean controls instead of truthiness coercion. A possible true branch still requires a member value. Conditions do not narrow previously acquired or observed wholes, and are not a Data/path-condition system. Compiler-generated conditional observations use the same member condition, observing the condition separately when required and observing the member only when it may be consumed. This is symbolic parameter construction, not a claim about wire serialization.
chinese: 可选请求成员：从实际值引用构造已知对象字段，保留原字段身份。build 成员可以带 Boolean when 引用：true 加入原值；false 省略成员且不消费其值；抽象 Boolean 保留两种可能。同一构造中的相同条件引用共享一次选择，因此共同控制的字段不能独立混合。条件是控制输入，不是请求内容；不要仅因存在性旗标控制可选参数，就把它添加为载荷。明确非 Boolean 的控制应拒绝，而不是做隐式真假转换。可能为 true 的分支仍需要成员值。条件不会缩小此前已取得或已观察的整体，也不是 Data／路径条件系统。编译器生成的条件观察使用相同成员条件：需要时单独观察条件，只在可能消费成员时观察成员。这是符号参数构造，不声称实际传输采用某种序列化。

title: EM15
english: Request delivery and acquisition: define one request value from actual parameter values and reference it consistently in deliver.inputs and the corresponding receive.inputs. At one IR and element scope, request/response association requires the same boundary and exactly the same ordered symbolic request references. One delivery matches at most one response; ambiguous matches are an explicit binding failure, not a closest-position, name-similarity, or FIFO guess. Acquisition reuses the matched delivery's actual input bindings, including literal identities and data versions, and follows its delivery. Known zero-argument calls and acquisition with no request remain possible under their existing rules. Response inputs describe request influence, not response contents and not a replacement for request delivery.
chinese: 请求交付与获取：用实际参数值定义一个请求值，并在 deliver.inputs 与对应 receive.inputs 中一致引用。在同一 IR 和元素作用域内，请求／响应关联要求边界相同，并且有序符号请求引用完全相同。一次交付最多匹配一个响应；歧义匹配是明确的绑定失败，不能按最近位置、名称相似性或 FIFO 猜测。获取复用已匹配交付的实际输入绑定，包括字面值身份和数据版本，并发生在该交付之后。已知零参数调用，以及无请求的获取，仍按现有规则允许。响应输入描述请求影响，不描述响应内容，也不能替代请求交付。
